insights: Proof by strong induction on deg(p): base deg≤1 trivial, inductive step uses Rolle
Rolle theorem (Mathlib: exists_deriv_eq_zero) gives derivative roots between consecutive polynomial roots
Sign-change accounting across derivative levels is the hardest part (~100-200 lines)
Building blocks needed: constant_no_roots, rolle_polynomial, root_of_sign_change (IVT)
Full proof estimated at 240-410 lines using existing OQ-02 infrastructure
Mathlib RuleOfSigns proves Descartes via factor-out-positive-root induction on root count, NOT via Rolle — uses succ_signVariations_le_X_sub_C_mul
Lifting Mathlib factor-out-root pattern to Budan requires a sign-change-preservation lemma for (X-r) * q at arbitrary evaluation points, NOT in Mathlib; difficulty profile equivalent to Rolle path
OQ-02-OQ-01 architectural bridge: file must import Proofs.DescartesRuleOfSignsOQ02 to discharge axiom (currently does not); existing BudanUpperBound-namespace helpers parallel to OQ-02 lemmas
Axiom-elimination strategy: split budan_upper_bound_axiom into _natDegree_zero (proved), _natDegree_one (proved), _natDegree_ge_two (honest residual axiom); narrows unproved mathematical content
mathlibGaps: No (X-r) * q sign-change-preservation lemma at arbitrary evaluation points; Mathlib only has succ_signVariations_le_X_sub_C_mul which is coefficient-based
